summary: This Form 6-K is a routine quarterly report by BW LPG Ltd, a foreign private issuer, announcing Q2 2026 financial results, an earnings presentation, and a cash dividend declaration. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring. Although it mentions second-hand vessel sales and a time charter, these are ordinary operational asset dispositions, not a strategic transaction requiring special-situation classification. The dividend is a regular quarterly distribution, not a special capital return. Thus, this filing does not meet any special-situations category.
